native_findings.finding: DISBAND GANG by the leader prints the confirmation prompt, stores Worldgroup session state 0x88 at session+0x1C and returns to the host without mutating the gang yet.
Confirmation requires exactly one parsed token and only tests whether that token's first character uppercases to Y. Y/YES/Yup confirm; blank, N, QUIT and multi-token replies cancel.

The confirm branch resolves the live user and gang, emits the disband/name-reuse warning to the gang, calls _remove_from_gang on the leader, saves/sends, then restores state 0x82. Lookup failure silently restores state 0x82.
Every non-confirming input emits 'Your gang has not been disbanded.' and restores state 0x82 without gang mutation.

Each invitation is a 0x1C heap node in the process-global list at 0x00488574/0x00488578 containing target user id, a 19-character gang name and next pointer. Exact duplicate target+gang nodes are rejected.

The transient list can be cleared for one user across every gang when gangName is null, or only for an exact user+gang pair when a gang name is supplied. Shared departure cleanup invokes the all-gangs form.

JOIN resolves the gang record, scans the transient invitation list for exact target+gang, increments native member count and assigns the gang only on a matching node. The helper does not reject a gang solely because its disband marker is already set.

No gang-invitation node belongs to the persistent character/gang record map. Invitations disappear on process restart; Reforged's pre-0342 persisted invite arrays are migrated once into live memory and removed from disk without a gameplay revision bump.

DISBAND PARTY detaches every direct follower, removes each detached user from the native group graph, then removes the caller from the group slots. It does not elect a successor and does not clear the caller's own leader pointer in this -1 branch.

runtime_corrections: DISBAND GANG is now a real state-0x88 modal operation instead of immediate mutation.
QUIT while the disband modal is pending is consumed as a non-Y cancel reply instead of exiting the session.
Telnet/local-console hosts suppress the ordinary gameplay prompt while the native modal owns input.
Gang invitations are process-local; persistent gang JSON is compatibility-migrated and normalized to an empty legacy invite array.
Successful gang JOIN clears all transient invitations for the joining character, matching the native clear owner.
Native gang member-count increments/decrements are reflected by Reforged theoretical member count.
DISBAND PARTY now routes to the recovered _stop_following(user,-1) owner rather than falling into the gang syntax path.
